DoclingServe_1_0_0_Info.keywords: Docling, Document Conversion, VLM, LLM, API, PDF, OCR, Pipeline, OpenAI-compatible, vLLM, Ollama
DoclingServe_1_0_0_Info.terms: VLM pipeline, Picture description, Table extraction, Layout analysis, Chunking
DoclingServe_1_0_0_Info.annotation: Docling Serve is a FastAPI-based document conversion microservice supporting PDF/HTML/Markdown processing with ML pipelines (OCR, VLM, Layout, Tables). Supports external VLM/LLM models via OpenAI-compatible API endpoints (vLLM, Ollama).

BusinessScenarios.Scenario: User -> Upload PDF/URL -> Convert to Markdown/JSON -> Receive structured document
User -> Submit batch -> Poll status -> Fetch result when ready
User -> Request with external_model_config -> Use Ollama/vLLM -> Process images/tables
